schemes.sectionSubtitle: Explore schemes and view rule-based eligibility evaluation matched against your citizen profile.
schemes.safeguardNotice: Preliminary Profile Evaluation: All scheme matches and criteria evaluations presented here are preliminary automated rule calculations based on your citizen profile. Final scheme rules and official sanction require manual verification by relevant government authorities and human welfare administrators. SahayAI does not guarantee official sanction or benefit disbursement.
schemes.emptyCatalogDesc: No schemes matched your search query or selected filters. Try broadening your keywords or clearing filters.
schemes.preliminaryMatchesDesc: Schemes whose rule conditions are satisfied or require document self-declaration. Official sanction requires human review.
schemes.noPreliminaryMatches: No schemes currently match all criteria for this application mode. Check the rule mismatches below or explore the full catalog.
schemes.mismatchesDesc: One or more rules did not align with your recorded profile. Note: These are automated preliminary checks and not official government rejections.
schemes.docBenefitNotice: Your citizen-confirmed documents are actively informing preliminary eligibility matches and verifying required application prerequisites.

applications.sectionSubtitle: Prepare, organize, and track your scholarship application drafts before final submission on official government portals.
applications.workspaceDisclaimer: SahayAI helps you prepare and organize your application draft and required documents. SahayAI does NOT directly submit applications to government portals. When ready, you will continue to the official National Scholarship Portal (NSP) for final submission.
applications.workspaceModalDisclaimer: SahayAI is an application assistance tool. Applications are NOT submitted directly by SahayAI to government portals. Official submission must be completed by the citizen on the official National Scholarship Portal (NSP).
applications.extPortalWarning1: You are now proceeding to the official government portal:
applications.extPortalWarning2: SahayAI does NOT automatically submit applications. You must complete your final registration and upload your documents on the official government website.
applications.extPortalWarning3: Your SahayAI draft will remain safely stored in your account so you can reference your details at any time.
applications.deleteDraftDesc: Are you sure you want to permanently delete this application draft? Any unconfirmed progress for this draft will be removed.
applications.deleteDraftWarning: This action cannot be undone. Saved documents in your My Documents library will NOT be deleted.

extension.modalIntro: During development, the SahayAI extension can be loaded directly from your repository in Google Chrome Developer Mode:
extension.step1Desc: Navigate to chrome://extensions/ in your browser.
extension.step2Desc: Toggle on the Developer mode switch in the top right corner.
extension.step3Desc: Click the 'Load unpacked' button in the top toolbar.
extension.step4Desc: Select the browser_extension folder in your SahayAI codebase.
